lesson: Any runner that batches N sub-tasks each with its own internal timeout MUST declare a total envelope >= sum(internal timeouts) + margin, on the tool that launches it. Default wrapper timeouts silently truncate long campaigns mid-flight.
evidence: 2026-09-04 E3E: 7 agents x timeout 600 each; wrapper default killed runner at 600s total. qwen survived, kimi truncated 67KB. Relaunch with 3600s budget completed 5 agents cleanly.
